title: Introducing the 1682 Advisory Committee
excerpt: In 1682, William Penn founded Philadelphia as a civic experiment rooted in tolerance, thoughtful planning, and the belief that communities shape the future. As the nation approaches its 250th anniversary, that legacy feels especially relevant.

children.text: We’re proud to introduce the inaugural 1682 Advisory Committee, a group of AI leaders who will help guide the conference as we prepare for our fifth event, to be held once again at the Barnes Foundation.

is intentionally curated for C-suite and senior executives responsible for AI strategy, budget allocation, and enterprise transformation. Attendance is selective by design, ensuring the room is composed of leaders with authority to act. This is what drives the depth of conversation and the quality of connections that define the 1682 experience.
The Advisory Committee will help shape speaker selection, topic curation, partnerships, and long-term vision, ensuring 1682 remains practitioner-focused and grounded in real-world execution.
The committee
Jon Flynn, Google

As Head of AI GTM for Google, Jon is at the forefront of embedding AI and intelligent agent technology into core operations for several industries including Gaming, Media & Entertainment, and Telcom. He has a passion for empowering creators through collaboration, deepening engagement, pushing boundaries, and building loyalty (not frustration). Jon was a keynote speaker at the 2025 1682 Conference.
Rick Nucci, Guru

Founder and CEO of Guru, which looks to reshape the way teams create, find, and share institutional knowledge. Previously, he co-founded Boomi, a cloud integration pioneer later acquired by Dell. Rick is also a longstanding leader in Philadelphia’s technology and startup ecosystem, Rick sponsored O3’s UX/UI Forge Conferences and was a 2024 1682 speaker.
Eliza Erickson, Government Innovation

With a civil servant heart Eliza is dedicated to ensuring it is easier to do business in Pennsylvania by specifically improving the permit ecosystem. She uses data and quantitative analytics to improve processes, culture and technology to do work faster, more equitably and innovatively. Eliza was a speaker at both the inaugural 2019 1682 conference and the 2025 one.
Tanmay Patel, Philadelphia Eagles

Tanmay brings a rare blend of enterprise AI strategy and data analytics to real-world execution at scale. He has worked in complex organizations and understands what it takes to move from experimentation to impact. His current position is with the Philadelphia Eagles, a cornerstone of the Philadelphia community.
Lindsay Hamlin, Best Egg

Lindsay brings a transformation lens shaped by hands-on AI integration within complex organizations. At Best Egg, she has led modernization efforts aligning systems, operations, and customer experience. Lindsay was a speaker at the 2025 1682 conference.
Philadelphia-driven. Intentionally curated.
Last year, 1682 welcomed more than 150 attendees to the Barnes Foundation and 75 more to NBCUniversal’s Lift Labs. Growth has never been about scale alone.
It is about curation.
As Philadelphia and the nation reflect on 250 years, 1682 continues the city’s tradition of convening leaders who are building what comes next.
More committee announcements and speaker reveals are coming soon.
This is the next chapter for
and for Philadelphia’s role in shaping the future of AI.
